hypotheses.statement: The current admitted G9 surface has a definition-call closure gap: it can denote call expressions but cannot define a reusable general executable function body through the published statement grammar.
hypotheses.falsifier: Production current-G9 parser/compiler compiles a reusable typed function definition and call without any additional declaration/lowering contract.

hypotheses.statement: A minimal typed function-definition surface can expose the prior universal-core function/call contract without introducing a new cognitive or FRANK-specific semantic primitive.
evidence: prior CC14 minimal universal core handoff
hypotheses.falsifier: Canonical typed-IR or target lowering requires a semantic distinction that cannot be represented by the prior universal-core function/call contract.

hypotheses.statement: Exact module/symbol/signature binding should be the default function-call resolution law; ClayGraph activation, UnifiedDB semantic proximity, GWT selection and model text must not substitute for definition identity.
hypotheses.falsifier: A verified alternative resolution mechanism provides equivalent deterministic/replayable binding and fail-closed ambiguity handling without hidden authority or semantic drift.

hypotheses.statement: The lowest-risk BASE repair is to materialize function-definition/signature semantics in the production frontend/canonical IR before adding new high-level sugar or FRANK-specific syntax.
hypotheses.falsifier: An alternative smaller implementation path closes the mandatory application suite while preserving semantic identity, type/effect checking and lowering receipts with less semantic surface.

hypotheses.statement: Function definition/call closure is necessary but not sufficient for BASE: branching, recursion/iteration, pattern matching, structured errors, memory/resource semantics, concurrency, FFI and real application lowering remain independent gates.
hypotheses.falsifier: The acceptance contract is formally revised or an equivalent smaller universal/system profile is proven and accepted with real application evidence.

counterhypotheses.statement: All reusable computation can remain in host/Needle adapters and G9 need only declare cognitive state/rules.
counterhypotheses.discriminating_test: Attempt APP-01..APP-10 with current G9 while requiring semantic-hash-preserving cross-backend portability and no hidden host semantics.

counterhypotheses.statement: Generic `rule` declarations already constitute executable functions and no function-definition surface is missing.
counterhypotheses.discriminating_test: Specify and execute a production rule-to-call lowering with typed arguments, return values, recursion/iteration behavior, error semantics and deterministic canonical identity.

counterhypotheses.statement: Function definitions should exist only in canonical IR and need no source-level G9 syntax.
counterhypotheses.discriminating_test: Compile real applications from existing source constructs into function-bearing IR without adding source syntax and compare complexity, semantic traceability and toolability against a minimal explicit function surface.
